verdict.rationale: The only evidence of event-triggered rules is Google Cloud's budget feature. Budget thresholds can trigger notifications, and the docs indicate automated cost-control responses through Pub/Sub topics. That makes this a narrow, domain-specific trigger rather than a general rules engine for events. Missing for 10: a general event-routing or trigger service evidenced in the pack, rules spanning arbitrary resource or service events, documentation of the configurable rule/condition model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
